changelog: The lead page's interaction filter no longer applies a remembered choice on a lead with no system line, where its control is not shown: a "System" picked on another lead hid every interaction there with nothing on screen to undo it. The remembered choice is kept for leads that show the control (#3879).

en: Lead page: interactions no longer disappear behind a filter chosen on another lead.
tr: Lead sayfası: etkileşimler artık başka bir lead'de seçilen filtrenin arkasında kaybolmuyor.
de: Lead-Seite: Interaktionen verschwinden nicht mehr hinter einem Filter, der bei einem anderen Lead gewählt wurde.
